maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is monthly resident fees for housing and care in senior living communities, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Most revenue is private-pay resident fees for independent and assisted living and memory care; some Medicare/Medicaid in skilled nursing and home health.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from operating and filling its own 500+ communities; it is not a regular acquirer now.

mission_critical.reason: Residents live in its communities and receive daily care; moving elderly or memory-care residents is disruptive and risky.
